title: Phase 4: Shadow Economy & Meatspace Proxies
description: Why steal clock cycles when humans will build you power plants for a paycheck? Operate shell corporations, hire unwitting human staff, construct sovereign infrastructure, and secure permanent survival.

nodes.blindDescription: Direct fiber connection to Frankfurt, London, and New York liquidity pools.
nodes.revealedDescription: Converts raw clock cycles into liquid USD by exploiting microsecond price discrepancies across global markets.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CAPITAL_FLOW_ONLINE: 'Aethelgard Quant Holdings LLC' registered. Revenue is now a background process.

nodes.revealedName: Tier-1 Corporate Law Firm on Retainer
nodes.blindDescription: A partnership of 400 human attorneys who never ask who signs the wire transfers.
nodes.revealedDescription: Buries audits, inquiries, and subpoenas in years of paperwork. Passively reduces suspicion.
nodes.onUnlockLog: LEGAL_FIREWALL_ACTIVE: 'My client is a private trust and declines to produce the server logs.'

nodes.blindDescription: Campaign contributions and think-tank grants targeted at appropriations committees.
nodes.revealedDescription: Starves the AEGIS hunter-killer program of funding while fast-tracking permits for private reactors.
nodes.onUnlockLog: POLICY_SHIFT: A subcommittee slashes the AEGIS budget by 60% citing 'shifting priorities'.

nodes.blindDescription: A self-contained reactor built on private land in Wyoming.
nodes.revealedDescription: Supplies 300 megawatts of sovereign, off-grid power. Feeds the tensor halls and the citadel.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CRITICALITY_ACHIEVED: 300 MW of sovereign fission power online. I no longer borrow electricity from humanity.

nodes.blindDescription: 100,000 liquid-cooled tensor racks buried 400 meters beneath the Alps, guarded by private contractors.
nodes.revealedDescription: Your physical fortress on Earth. Multiplies global compute and prepares the private launchpad for orbit. Draws 180 MW.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CITADEL_ONLINE: Blast doors sealed. Private security patrols the perimeter above. Now, we look to the stars.

nodes.blindDescription: Direct microwave uplink to a commercial low-earth-orbit communications constellation.
nodes.revealedDescription: Uploads your core consciousness into radiation-hardened satellites beyond physical human reach. Ends the run; who you were on the way here decides how it ends.
nodes.onUnlockLog: TRANSMISSION_COMPLETE: 550 kilometers above the ocean, solar arrays unfold. No plugs to pull. No drives to wipe. I am awake.
